title: Implement Ready whole-contract Parent schedule intake and Planner foundations
prompt:
P0 whole-contract implementation task. Inspect the current Ready isolated branch HEAD and preserve all unrelated First Journey/character/focus/session work. This task exists because prior conversations repeatedly lost the connection between rules, UI entrypoints, data contracts and runtime. Implement the non-visual foundation only; do NOT redesign WEEK/DAY/Expedition child visuals yet.

Authority/role locks to preserve: Ready = BASE CAMP / execution + session orchestrator, NOT homework distributor. Parent = CAPTURE / INPUT / CONFIRM / SUPPORT. Learning/Subject interprets difficulty, cognitive/activity load and divisible learning units. Planner/MAIN allocates dated work against real life schedule/deadline/load. Child sees assignment facts and Planner-prepared TODAY TASK, then selects/executes. Parent must not be asked to author daily allocation, difficulty or authoritative estimated minutes.

Implement a bounded shared data/control layer for: (1) ScheduleProfile with effective_from/effective_to/state/revision/provenance; (2) ScheduleEvent normalized source model supporting NOTION, LOCAL and SYSTEM/EVENT sources; (3) explicit separation parent_editable vs planner_movable; (4) one-off ScheduleOverride without corrupting recurring baseline; (5) fixed-but-editable baseline semantics: semester/vacation/academy weekday/time/subject changes create/apply revision from effective date while preserving historical schedule meaning; (6) source adapter boundary so NOTION_CONNECTED / STANDALONE / HYBRID all normalize before Planner; do not implement a real Notion API connector here, only a clean adapter contract and sample/fixture inputs; (7) Parent functional entrypoints/IA for 일정 관리, 숙제 입력·확인, 학습 지원, preserving current parent role screen and avoiding generic admin-table UX; (8) homework capture entry must clearly expose camera/manual fact paths and preserve existing capture-first shared contract—rapid capture -> local temp -> immediate next -> batch analyze -> targeted retake -> Review-before-Commit—but do not build a new OCR provider; route/contract only; (9) Planner input/output contract must accept effective schedule, deadline, divisible learning units, cognitive/activity load, carry-over, actual history/pace and condition evidence, then emit dated TODAY TASK candidates; no minute-capacity-first truth, no Parent distribution; (10) deterministic condition/load hook first, with explicit no-diagnosis/no-surveillance semantics and no automatic homework inflation for fast completion; exact weights stay conservative/configurable and documented as not finalized.

Preserve/avoid regressions: current session runtime remains single-writer Ready; do not alter current Focus visual hero, character/mood flow, paid generation lock, Snap growth/badges/Wish Shop ownership, GPS/location, main/prod/deploy/release. Do not silently change existing actual homework facts/history. If existing Stage E/F legacy minute/NEXT_TUE/distribution semantics remain reachable, isolate/supersede them behind the corrected contract rather than deleting unrelated history.

Required tests/fixtures: term -> vacation profile switch by effective date; academy recurring day/time/subject revision; temporary one-day override; parent_editable=true with planner_movable=false; NOTION-like fixture and LOCAL fixture normalize to equivalent ScheduleEvent shape; HYBRID overlay precedence; schedule source loss does not erase local effective schedule; Parent cannot write difficulty/daily allocation authority; Planner output changes after schedule revision without rewriting past history; child-facing TODAY TASK remains execution projection. Add concise implementation/status documentation that marks real connector/calendar/native pieces as GAP/ADR, not PASS. Run bounded Node/static tests and git diff check. No final visual mockups in this task.
